item.text: The queue already exposes file size in `meta.size` and updates it when a folder or archive size becomes known. Preview has `link.size`. I’ll use one selection function for both the file saver and the metric, so the threshold, unsupported browser behavior, and service worker fallback follow the same rule.

The metric is registered as the v1 `web_drive_download_mechanism_success_rate_total` counter, and the hook now emits it beside the existing success rate counter. I’ve connected preview reporting to `link.size`; I’m adding focused checks for mechanism choice, retry labels, terminal outcomes, and preview size propagation.

The metrics package type check passed. The focused Drive tests and Drive type check are still running; once they finish, I’ll address any failures and verify the metric name and labels in the final diff.

item.text:
Implemented the Drive download mechanism metric. Terminal downloads now increment `drive_download_mechanism_success_rate_total` with status, retry, and mechanism labels. The [file saver](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_downloads/fileSaver/fileSaver.ts) exposes `selectMechanismForDownload(size)` and uses it for saving; stateful downloads use `meta.size`, and previews pass their file size through the [metrics hook](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_downloads/DownloadProvider/useDownloadMetrics.ts). Buffered downloads now reach Done only after saving succeeds. The v1 [schema](/app/packages/metrics/types/web_drive_download_mechanism_success_rate_total_v1.schema.d.ts) is registered in the metrics client.

Validation passed: 20 Drive tests, 17 metrics tests, both package type checks, formatting, and lint with no errors.
